nights.name: Bleood
nights.extract: Jamari Isiaha Spencer-Brown, known professionally as Bleood, is an American rapper and record producer. He initially emerged as a member of New York City rapper Xaviersobased's collective 1c34.

en.who: Jamari Isiaha Spencer-Brown, known professionally as Bleood, is an American rapper and record producer. he initially emerged as a member of a collective belonging to New York City rapper Xaviersobased.
facts: he initially emerged as a member of the collective 1c34.
the collective 1c34 belongs to New York City rapper Xaviersobased.

de.who: Jamari Isiaha Spencer-Brown, unter dem künstlernamen Bleood bekannt, ist ein amerikanischer rapper und musikproduzent. er trat zunächst als mitglied des kollektivs 1c34 in erscheinung, das dem rapper Xaviersobased aus New York City gehört.
facts: er trat zunächst als mitglied des kollektivs 1c34 in erscheinung.
das kollektiv 1c34 gehört dem rapper Xaviersobased aus New York City.

tr.who: Jamari Isiaha Spencer-Brown, sahne adıyla Bleood, amerikalı bir rapçi ve müzik yapımcısıdır. ilk olarak New York City'li rapçi Xaviersobased'in kolektifi 1c34'ün üyesi olarak öne çıktı.
facts: ilk olarak 1c34 kolektifinin üyesi olarak öne çıktı.
bu kolektif New York City'li rapçi Xaviersobased'e aittir.
